kanjiPlan.title: recommend; encourage
kanjiPlan.meaningBoundary: Recommending, advising or encouraging someone toward an action; 勧める also recommends an item/person or offers something for acceptance. These acts do not establish acceptance or success. Encouragement toward an action and emotional encouragement can overlap; do not make a strict semantic partition against 励ます.
kanjiPlan.radicalAndShape: Canonical indexing radical 力/no.19 is visible at right. Use a labelled modern-shape mnemonic: imagine putting strength into urging someone onward. The dense left side contains a 隹-like lower shape; identify layout visually, not as a claim about a bird's historical semantic role. KanjiVG's 雚V phon annotation is not independent historical scholarship.
kanjiPlan.phonetic: Omit field and facts-line item. Historical classification remains unverified; structure-unclassified is intentional, not proof that no phonetic component exists.

readingRows.allocationEvidence: Full1210970 has unrestricted 勧告/かんこく; the independent Daijisen character entry labels 勧カン and explicitly lists 勧告. Raw告 and its actual N3 card independently supply コク. Thus カン+コク is supported by the character and compound evidence, not inferred only from a kana substring.
readingRows.usefulness: One necessary compound for recommending action. No vocabulary level inferred from N1 membership.

readingRows.disposition: Retain exact source metadata/order and supply a qualified source-only reading-table row. No usable per-character ケン example was established in the complete46 member families; this batch does not offer a ケン question.
readingRows.qualification: Not evidence that ケン is invalid, obsolete or rare. Do not turn Daijisen's narrower on-list into a refutation, invent an example, import nanori, or silently remove/reorder the full reading.

readingRows.allocationEvidence: The single-kanji native verb writes すす with 勧 and める in kana. Full1595680 restricts senses1/3 to 勧める/奨める; sense2 item/person recommendation is unrestricted, especially 薦める. The rare-spelling flag belongs to 奨める, not the pronunciation すすめる.
readingRows.usefulness: Reuse actual existing N3 article, all three already taught senses and its primary reading. The same-sounding 進める is a different verb, not an unrestricted spelling substitute.

curatedDistractors.rationale: Similar dense left shape, but 見 at right instead of 力. Full raw meanings outlook/look/appearance/condition/view and complete actual card do not supply recommend/encourage.
Similar dense shape on the right, but 石 at left. Full raw assurance/firm/tight/hard/solid/confirm/clear/evident are not urging or recommending. Encouraging someone does not establish certainty.

Related-looking dense shape at right with 木 at left, rather than right-hand 力. Full raw authority/power/rights and actual card's nonphysical-power distinction do not mean recommend or encourage. An authority may recommend an action, but actor association is not a synonym.

directGuardRationale.evidence: Exact encourage overlap in both full raw records, member1595680sense1 and comparison1557350sense1/1253760. Declaration on new勧 suffices symmetrically; retain all original 励 guards unchanged.

Raw勧 offer, member1595680sense3 offering a drink/seat, and actual供 ordinary provision/offering plus rawoffer/serve meal. A different accompany half does not make the broad offer label safely wrong for勧. This does not equate deity-offering供える with every tea-offering勧める.

Conservative direct safeguard: full raw勉 explicitly includes encourage, and the new broad encourage label could be defensible in that orientation. Actual勉 emphasizes effort; no modern standalone encouraging verb or unrestricted substitution is established. This pair is not inherited transitively from 励's existing guard.

Conservative displayed-label safeguard: actual支/支える include nonphysical and emotional support, and new勧's broad encourage label can overlap that supportive interpretation. No claim that every支 is advice, or every practical support act is勧める; this is a direct pair, not transitivity through励.

otherComparedLabels.disposition: Not a curated wrong option. Member勧進/勧誘 concern solicitation, while full1514830 retains募集 applications/contributions and finance. A compound's whole gloss is not automatically every constituent's standalone meaning. No demonstrated direct title equivalence; retain actual finite-pool inspection as an acceptance gate.

Not a curated wrong option. Complete招く includes asking/beckoning/summoning/causing. Whole勧誘 can mean invitation, but this alone does not establish invite as a character-level gloss of勧. Do not invent a rigid recommendation-versus-invitation rule.
Not a curated wrong option. Warnings can recommend action, but recommending an item or offering tea is not intrinsically warning. No universal substitution or semantic-safety claim.
Raw offer prayers is not a generic offer meaning; actual card concerns ritual/worship. No direct label collision established.
Raw offer sympathy is a phrase-level sense, not evidence that visit/call on means recommend/encourage. No direct label collision established.

kanjiPlan.compatibleClient: Approved Android125 reading curation and132 direct symmetric nontransitive kanji guards required. Older apps ignore them. Finite actual production option samples and rendered review remain mandatory; no global semantic guarantee.

newNecessary.title: recommendation; advice
newNecessary.jlptDisposition: Omit jlpt: no separate vocabulary source level adopted. Necessary カン support, not a new N1 vocabulary section.
newNecessary.meaningBoundary: Advice or a recommendation to take an action. Teach noun and transitiveする; personに and actionを, exemplified by 辞職を勧告する. Can occur in institutional recommendations, but do not claim only authorities use it, it is always gentle, or all legal systems treat it identically.
newNecessary.combination: 勧 recommending/urging + 告 telling/informing: conveying advice about action. A learner-oriented combination account, not historical etymology or a claim that every whole compound gloss belongs independently to both components. On カン+コク.
